---
name: Bet slip
about: Put a bet you've placed (NFL or football) on My bets and follow it live. Attach a screenshot or photo of the slip.
title: "Bet slip"
labels: bet-slip
---

Attach a screenshot of the placed bet (bet365 → My Bets, Spreadex, or any bookmaker's app), or a clear photo of a paper slip. NFL and football both work: accas, BTTS, over/under goals, result, goal in both halves. Several images are fine for a long slip or several bets. Reply **confirm** to the reading and the bet goes on My bets. If the slip doesn't show the match date, say it here (e.g. "games are Saturday").

This repo is public: before attaching, cover or crop out your **stake and return**, balance, name, bet reference and any barcode. Your stake never goes on the site; add it on My bets afterwards and it stays on your phone.
